Scenario fixture: page-language-present

01 — PASS: the language is on <body>, a parent of every text, and not on <html>

Whole-document check: one outcome per page. RGAA 8.3.1 accepts a language given on each text or on one of its parents, so this page passes, although html-lang-attr-present fails it under WCAG 3.1.1. The failing, xml:lang and notApplicable branches are covered by this rule's inline tests.
